name: assignmentos
description: Student-centered assignment workspace and service scaffold

scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:ai" --names "API,WEB,AI" --prefix-colors "blue,green,magenta"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
